about.title: Studio
about.headline: A small studio of one.
about.bio1: I'm Ofek Karavani, a freelance full-stack developer based in Ashdod, Israel. I work with businesses, founders, and creatives — building everything from fast landing pages to e-commerce stores, custom systems, and AI-powered web apps.
about.bio2: I care about three things: that the build is well-engineered underneath, that it ships fast, and that the surface feels considered. Each project is a direct collaboration — no agency layer, no middlemen.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: Plain-language summary of what this site does with your information. No dark patterns, no hidden data flows.
collectItems: Contact form — your name, email, and message. These are emailed to me through Resend (resend.com) and arrive in my inbox. They are not stored in any database; the only persistent copy is in my email.
localStorage — your selected language (key: portfolio_lang) so the site remembers your choice between visits. Stored only in your browser; never transmitted.
privacy.noTitle: What this site does NOT do
noItems: No analytics, no third-party tracking, no advertising cookies, no fingerprinting.
No social media trackers, no remarketing pixels, no behavioural profiling.
Fonts are loaded from the local bundle (self-hosted), not from external CDNs.
thirdPartyItems: Vercel — hosting (vercel.com). Standard server access logs apply.
Resend — email delivery (resend.com), only when you submit the contact form.
privacy.rightsBody: Under Israel's Privacy Protection Law (1981) and the EU GDPR, you can request access, correction, or deletion of any data you have sent through the contact form. Email ofek.karavani1@gmail.com and I will action it within 30 days.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.intro: This site is built to meet the WCAG 2.2 AA standard and the Israel Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Regulations (Service Accessibility Adjustments), 5773-2013.
featuresItems: Semantic landmarks: header, nav, main, section, footer.
Keyboard navigable. Visible focus rings on every interactive element.
Body text and interactive elements meet AA color contrast.
prefers-reduced-motion respected — entrance animations and the marquee stop automatically.
Image alt text and ARIA labels on interactive controls.
Bilingual interface (Hebrew + English) with full RTL support.
Mobile-first responsive layout, tested down to 360 px.
accessibility.knownBody: Some Framer Motion section transitions are decorative and may not be described to screen readers. The desktop project hover preview is not surfaced on touch devices — those devices see an inline thumbnail instead. I am continuing to improve coverage.
accessibility.reportBody: If you encounter an accessibility issue, please email ofek.karavani1@gmail.com with the page URL and a description of the problem. I will respond within a few business days and remediate.
